name: Yuutarou
source:
An ordinary writer who creates, longing to be like [url=https://vndb.org/c132908]God[/url]. One night, at 4 AM, he meets a mysterious girl called "[url=https://vndb.org/c132905]Feni[/url]" in a park. She entrusts him with a mysterious, golden bird's egg. If he can make someone happy, the phoenix can rise again.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/11/10/manimani/]Official Website[/url]]
